Server & connection

Noctua stores your library and runs AI on the connected server. Closing the desktop app leaves the server and its tasks running.

Where do you want to work?

AI CLIs, API keys, Zotero paths and data folders belong to the server computer. Local AI setup is unnecessary for a remote connection.

No active connection.

Choose a connection to begin.

Switching checks every open tab for unsaved notes, files, PDF comments and chat drafts. Failed saves keep the current connection. Tasks continue on their original server; changing servers does not move them.


This computer’s server
These controls always manage this computer, even while you use a remote server. Switching connections does not stop a local server.


Login auto-start is separate from starting a background server. Turning it off leaves the current server running. Service errors are shown here.


Desktop
Desktop updates leave the server running. Update the server explicitly when its tasks are finished; its executable is kept separately from the app bundle.
